inspection: Smooth rounded bulge under the skin behind the ear near the incision, no surface liquid, same person and view.

observers.observation:
1. The back and right side of a person's head, neck, and upper shoulder, viewed from behind and slightly to the right. Short dark hair on top, shaved/faded sides, one ear in profile, the cheek and lashes of a closed or downcast right eye.

2. A round, smooth, pinkish dome-shaped swelling sits directly behind the ear, pushing the outer ear forward. Its edge is outlined by a thin pale highlight; the surrounding skin is slightly flushed. Nothing is worn or applied; no cut, scab, or open wound.

3. No text, arrows, labels, or symbols.

4. Could be mistaken for a large boil, cyst, or tumor behind the ear, or for a swollen lymph node.

observers.observation:
1. The back and right side of a person's head, neck, and upper shoulder, seen from behind and slightly to the right; the right ear, cheek, and one closed eye with eyelashes are visible in profile. The hair is short and dark on top with buzzed, faded sides.

adjudication.label: Semantic adjudicator (Claude)
recovered: (a) rounded swelling/bulge under the skin behind the ear — all three observers report a round, smooth, dome-shaped swelling directly behind the right ear with skin stretched but intact
(b) no liquid on the surface — no observer reports droplets, sweat, or running liquid; the only 'shiny'/highlight mentions are surface reflections on the stretched skin
(c) same view of the head from behind — all three observers describe the back and right side of the head seen from behind and slightly to the right, right ear in profile
adjudication.reason: All three observers independently recovered the rounded subcutaneous bulge behind the right ear, the from-behind view, and an intact, liquid-free surface; Observer 1's 'slightly flushed' and Observer 3's 'pinkish-red' fall short of strong redness, and the boil/cyst/tumor/lymph node/abscess alternative readings are permitted under this contract.
